lines.text: They were held at Sendamangalam, the chief's fortified capital.
Rajaraja's ally, the Hoysala king Vira Narasimha the Second, sent armies south.
Kadava towns were sacked. As the siege closed in, the chief asked for peace.

lines.text: Inscriptions say the emperor was set free at Tiruvendipuram.
